scenario.note: A rule to ensure that at least 60% of the total ore extracted is from Mine4.
The number of mine-years worked for Mine2 is at least 1.5 times that for Mine1.
The rule enforces that the total number of mine-years kept open is at most 90% of the total number of mine-years worked. The objective remains to maximise the discounted profit.
A relative limit on the tons of blended ore sold for Year5 compared to Year3.
Two relative limits: Year2's blended ore must be at least 75% of total, and Year2's mine-years worked must be at least 1.25 times Year5's.
A relative rule limits the sum of extraction from Mine3 to 15% of the total extraction across all mines.
The number of mine-years kept open for Mine1 is at least twice that for Mine3.
The rule ensures that the number of mine-years worked in Year5 is at least 50% of the total mine-years worked in the previous four years.
Two relative limits on the total tons of ore extracted: one for Year2 and one for the entire horizon.
Two relative limits are applied: one on the number of mine-years kept open in Year2 relative to the total, and one on the tons of blended ore sold in Year1 relative to Year4.
A rule limits the blended ore sold in Year2 to 10% of the total blended ore sold in other years.
A rule that enforces the total number of mine-years kept open is at least 1.5 times the total number of mine-years worked.
A rule that enforces the extracted tons of Mine2 to be at least twice that of Mine1.
The rule ensures that Mine4 accounts for at least 75% of the total mine-years worked across all mines.
Two relative limits: the number of mine-years worked for Year2 is at least 3 times that for Year4; Year1's blended ore is at most 20% of the total.
A rule that enforces the blended ore sold in Year1 to be at least twice the blended ore sold in Year4.
Rules enforce that at least 75% of total extracted ore goes to Year1 and that the number of mine-years kept open in Year2 is at most 90% of that in Year1.
Rules bound the SUM of a decision measure over a scope; a relative rule compares two such sums.
The rule enforces that the total extraction in Year1 is at least three times that of Year2.
A rule limiting the blended ore sold in Year4 to 75% of that sold in Year3.
